app.name: Energy flow
app.summary: Live power flow of solar, grid, battery and house, with wallbox, heat pump and the price of the hour.
app.tile_example: Solar, grid, battery, house, wallbox and heat pump
app.hint_power: A power sensor in W or kW.
app.hint_grid: W or kW, positive while power comes from the grid.
app.hint_home: W or kW: the house without the wallbox and heat pump, which show as their own branches.
app.hint_battery: W or kW, positive while the battery discharges.
app.hint_heat: Thermal power in W or kW; shown beside the heat pump while it runs.
app.hint_price: In EUR/kWh, shown under the grid in ct.
app.hint_price_m3: In EUR/kWh: the price with the time-of-use grid fee of §14a module 3 (NT 23:00-06:45, HT 08:30-15:15 and 17:15-21:15, January to March and October to December). Leave empty to hide it.
